cocomm.q: The commentator asks: 'What's going wrong for the lads today?'
a: "We're too narrow. Their full-backs are getting forward and nobody's tracking them."
"Honestly? The ref's useless and our left-back's slower than my nan."

cocomm.q: 'Their striker's having a great game. What do you make of him?'
a: "Clever movement. He drifts off the centre-half's shoulder, then attacks the near post."
"He's got two feet and he uses them."
"He's alright. My rival {RIVAL} reckons he's better than me. He's not."
"Clumsy from the defender. He's gone to ground too early. Fair decision."
"I'd want it if it was us."
"Robbery. The ref's been bought. Write that down."

interview.journalist: Dame Fiona Bluntly (the nation's most feared interviewer)

questions.q: Let's start simply. Why should anyone believe you're sorry?
a: "Because I am. What I did was wrong and I let a lot of people down."
"Look, everyone makes mistakes, it's been blown out of proportion."

questions.q: Who exactly did you let down?
a: "My family. My teammates. The fans who bought my shirt. Kids who looked up to me."
"I'm working with a charity every week, and I've paid back what I can. I'll earn it back, slowly."
"I just want to focus on my football."
